name: Blueberry Festival in Otter Lake, Michigan
tagline: Otter Lake: One of Michigan's Largest Blueberry Festivals Returns
description: Blueberry Festival in Otter Lake, Michigan is a independent farm in Otter Lake, MI. It grows Blueberries and Corn, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
